instruction: Browse Batman toys for kids and sort by lowest price.

metadata.explanation: Similar toy browsing task with Batman instead of Spider-Man. Uses same interaction pattern: navigate to category and sort by price ascending.
metadata.verification: Task uses existing check_direct_json_object metric and get_active_tab_html_parse getter. No custom functions needed. Evaluator checks breadcrumb navigation and URL parameters match expected product category and sort order.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks all instruction requirements: Batman category, Toys category, Kids category, and price sorting (lowest to highest)
Getter logic (get_active_tab_html_parse with category='class&url') can extract breadcrumb navigation elements from HTML class 'pmpSearch_breadcrumb' to verify category hierarchy
Getter can extract sort selector text from HTML class 'sbSelector' to verify price sorting is set to 'Price Low-High'
Getter checks URL parameters to verify search and sort state (checks for 'Batman', 'Toys', 'Kids', and 'S=4' parameter)
Metric (check_direct_json_object) correctly compares extracted boolean flags against expected values
Expected values structure correctly maps to getter output: expects 'batman', 'toys', 'kids', 'price low-high' as true, with case-insensitive matching
The evaluator includes 'is_other_exist' check to ensure no unexpected filters are applied
Complete coverage of both navigation (category selection) and sorting requirements from the instruction
